_comment: The roles a list item's key or a draft item field can play, read from the words of its name (camelCase split, lower case), in priority order: a key's primary role is the first role any of its words names, a field may take each role its words name, in this order. A word may sit under several roles (`name` is an author or a title, `text` a quote or a description): lib/fill-list-content.mjs::matchFields gives a field a key whose primary role it plays first, and only when the block's item has none does a key that names the role later in this list take it (a team member's `name` takes a draft `title` when the item has no title key). Read by lib/fill-list-content.mjs; data/item-roles.schema.json is its shape.
